sections.heading: Transmittal Letter
sections.text: Republic of the Philippines COMMISSION ON AUDIT Commonwealth Avenue, Quezon City LOCAL GOVERNMENT SECTOR National Capital Region August 25, 2021 Mayor FRANCISCO “ISKO MORENO” DOMAGOSO City of Manila Dear Mayor Domagoso: We are pleased to transmit the Annual Audit Report on the City of Manila for Calendar Year 2020, pursuant to Section 2, Article IX-D of the Philippine Constitution and Section 43 of Presidential Decree No. 1445, otherwise known as the Government Auditing Code of the Philippines. The report consists of the Independent Auditor's Report, Audited Financial Statements, Observations and Recommendations, and Status of Implementation of Prior Years' Audit Recommendations. The Auditor rendered a qualified opinion on the fairness of presentation of the financial statements of the City in view of the significance of the exceptions noted in audit as stated in the Independent Auditor's Report. The audit observations together with the recommended courses of action, which were discussed with the concerned management officials and staff during the exit conference on August 5, 2021, are presented in detail in Part II of the report. We request that the recommendations contained in the report be immediately implemented and we will appreciate being informed of the action taken thereon within 60 days from receipt hereof pursuant to Section 89 of the General Provisions of the General Appropriations Act of FY 2020 (Republic Act No. 11465), using the Agency Action Plan and Status of Implementation (AAPSI) Form to be submitted to the Audit Team. We acknowledge the support and cooperation that you and your staff extended to the Audit Team, thus, facilitating the submission of this report. Very truly yours, COMMISSION ON AUDIT By: Atty. RESURRECCION C. QUIETA Acting Regional Director Copy furnished: The Presiding Officer, Sangguniang Panlungsod, City of Manila The Bureau of Local Government Finance The Secretary, Department of the Interior and Local Government National Library (soft copy) University of the Philippines (soft copy) COA Commission Central Library (soft copy)
